# A new regular folder keeps special folders first after manual ordering

The folder-added listener assigns sort order before adding the row. setSortOrderOnNewFolder leaves already ordered new folders and never-manually-sorted groups alone. For an ordered group it excludes SpecialUse siblings from candidates, sorts remaining candidates by compareFolders and finds a later localized name; insertion uses that sibling, otherwise it appends after the maximum order. This preserves special folders and the existing custom group order rather than alphabetizing the whole group. The regression creates Boo after a simulated drag and directly asserts the full URI array with Trash/Outbox before Boo and the custom regular-folder order retained. This JS numeric localized-name comparator is separate from Panorama native folder comparison. No browser test or native drag ran.

Scope: 3pane manual folder order insertion.
